rules: The accepted V21 eye frame is the immutable positional reference.
Generated content belongs inside the eye aperture; do not regenerate the frame when avoidable.
Keep content centered on content_center unless the intended motion explicitly changes it.
Keep all content inside safe_bbox during authoring.
Use 10x10 only for exploration, not as final runtime truth.
Convert selected ideas into small sequence-specific grids before normalization and packing.
Normalize and QA content frames independently from the accepted eyelid/frame animation.
Pupil/content motion must never alter the accepted frame pivot or blink alignment.
